accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full tab ordering and focus rings on interactive elements

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete role-aware Drilling Intelligence Workstation for SIH26121: NWIS / eRTMAC-NWIS.
Support clear Demo Auth role switching at top header: [Engineer View] and [System Admin View].

Engineer flow must feature: Well Intelligence Map, Current Well, Nearby/Similar Wells, Events Timeline, Risk/Alerts with 'Why-this-alert' evidence drawer, AI Assistant query bar, and Document Provenance viewer.
System Admin flow must feature: System Overview, Users/Roles, Access Policies, Data Ingestion Queue, Database Health, and Operational Audit Logs.
Hide drilling intelligence operational data when in System Admin mode, and hide admin configuration panels when in Engineer mode.
All non-confirmed backend endpoints MUST be explicitly tagged with a visual '[MOCK API]' or '[FUTURE ENDPOINT]' badge.
Ensure every clickable and data element includes a role-based 'data-testid' attribute (e.g. data-testid='role-switch-admin-btn').
Use light workstation palette: navy headers (#0F172A), Slate workspace (#F1F5F9), white panels (#FFFFFF), crisp border hierarchy (#E2E8F0), and vivid risk signals.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default components.
DO NOT use dark gradients over large areas; keep background clean light slate (#F1F5F9) with stark dark navy accents.
Always add data-testid attributes to buttons, input fields, tabs, table rows, and modals.
Ensure high contrast on all text and button hover states.
Handle all UI states smoothly: loading spinners/skeletons, empty data states, error states, and mock endpoint indicators.
